component.name: Cassette
component.summary: Apple Music, à la façon d’elementary

description.p: Cassette plays Apple Music in an elementary OS window: header bar, light and dark styles, media keys and the sound indicator (MPRIS), a mini player and track notifications. An Apple Music subscription is required.

Cassette lit Apple Music dans une fenêtre elementary OS : barre d’en-tête, styles clair et sombre, touches multimédia et indicateur de son (MPRIS), mini-lecteur et notifications de piste. Un abonnement Apple Music est nécessaire.
Cassette is a fork of Sidra by Martin Wimpress. Apple Music is a trademark of Apple Inc.; Cassette is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.
Cassette est un fork de Sidra de Martin Wimpress. Apple Music est une marque d’Apple Inc. ; Cassette n’est ni affiliée à Apple ni approuvée par Apple.

A side panel of Cassette's own replaces Apple's: time-synced lyrics that follow the song, the queue with a click to jump to a track, and search, which plays a song or opens an album, artist or playlist.
Mini player: the window shrinks to its header bar, with the artwork, the track and the playback controls.
The Settings window has the raspberry header bar of the main window.
The disk cache is capped at 256 MB; it grew past 1 GB with streamed tracks.
Last.fm scrobbling and game controller navigation are removed.
Covalence is now called Boomerang: texts and keywords follow.
Own repository and releases, AppStream data, fuller credits and licence notices, links in the About window.
First release: Sidra 1.1.2 reworked for elementary OS.
